_about: C01: layouts read from the 2016 client's handlers (Fiesta.bin). 'basis' = client function. Names in the 'name' field are descriptive (ours) unless the opcode catalog has one.

0x0c0f.name: WM login (ours)
fields: W01 name; built by client FUN_00471b30
copied from the login server's 0x0C0C reply
0x0c0f.notes: 0x140 bytes; sent right after 0x0807 on the WM connection

0x0c14.name: WM login OK (ours)
fields: number of AVATAR records (W01 confirms server-side)
handed to the account object FUN_006613b0
0x0c14.notes: the client then switches to the character-select scene

0x0c15.name: WM login refused (ours)
fields: 0x44 bad key / 0x46 DB error (W01); the client does not read it
0x0c15.notes: the client leaves the scene without reading the code

fields: 0x141 world server, 0x142/0x143 map server, 0x144 empty slot, 0x582..0x595 '<part> information' errors, other: map maintenance
0x1002.notes: failure reply to 0x1001; the success reply is 0x1003 (inferred from the client's use)

0x1003.name: character login OK (ours)
0x1003.notes: client connects to the zone and sends 0x1801

0x1404.name: character create failed (ours)
fields: 0x82 failed, 0x83 wrong class, 0x84 name taken, 0x85 max slot, 0x181 name in use

0x140a.name: character delete failed (ours)
fields: 199: 'You may not delete guild leader.'; other: 'Unable to delete a Guild Master character.'

0x1079.name: beauty shop result (ours)
fields: 0x1280 ok, 0x1281/0x1282 DB error, 0x1283 item needed, 0x1284 unknown, 0x1286 gender change

0xb40c.name: rename-by-item result (ours)
fields: 0x20C0 ok, 0x20C7 guild master not allowed, 0x20D1 name taken

0x1801.name: NC_MAP_LOGIN_REQ
fields: one 32-byte entry per checked SHN file (client table DAT_00b533c0)
